text: In the mapped area, every way to viale Isonzo has at least one crossing without a signal. With a stop at the supermarket Lidl for 15 minutes: Route A, on foot, 30 minutes with the shopping, the same time as the shortest: 1 crossing without a signal, the fewest of any route in the mapped area. Route B, on foot, the shortest, 30 minutes with the shopping: 3 crossings without a signal. Route C, on foot to Lidl, then bus 90 from Viale Umbria (Lodi M3): 38 minutes with the shopping and 2 minutes of waiting after it, 19 of them on foot, with 4 crossings without a signal. You chose route A.
